content: शान्तिः {%f.%} [शम्-क्तिन्] .²1 Pacification, allayment, alleviation, removal; अध्वरविघातशान्तये <ls>R. 11. 1</ls>, <ls n="R. 11.">62</ls>. .²2 Calmness, tranquillity, quiet, ease, rest, repose; स्मर संस्मृत्य न शान्तिरस्ति मे <ls>Ku. 4. 17</ls>; शान्तिः कुतस्तस्य भुजङ्गशत्रोः <ls>Māl. 6. 1</ls>; यत् किंचिद् वस्तु संप्राप्य स्वल्पं वा यदि वा बहु . या तुष्टिर्जायते चित्ते सा शान्तिः कथ्यते बुधैः .. <ls>Padma P.</ls> .²3 Cessation of hostility; सर्पस्य शान्तिः कुटिलस्य मैत्री विधातृसृष्टौ न हि दृष्टपूर्वा <ls>Bv. 1. 125</ls>. .²4 Cessation, stop. .²5 Absence of passion, quietism, complete indifference to all worldly enjoyments; तदुपहितकुटुम्बः शान्तिमार्गोत्सुकोऽभूत् <ls>R. 7. 71</ls>. .²6 Consolation, solace. .²7 Settlement of differences, reconciliation. .²8 Satisfaction of hunger. .²9 An expiatory rite, a propitiatory rite for averting evil; शान्तयश्चापि वर्धन्तां यथाकल्पं यथाविधि <ls>Rām. 1. 8. 16</ls>. .²10 Good fortune, felicity, auspiciousness. .²11 Exculpation or absolution from blame. .²12 Preservation. .²13 <ab>N.</ab> of Durgā. .²14 Destruction, end, death.
